Note: As checked the charger there is
DC1_StateMonitor_KF13 & DC2_StateMonitor_KF13 error.
Rebooted the charger but problem remains the same.
There is Fast shutdown error in DC1 & DC2 so there multiple are possibilities, please check below points in charger & also carry spare State Monitor
1) Check connection between State monitor & Converters.
CONNECTION between F02-TB1.. TB15 to F03-KF13 TO FAST SHUTDOWN DC1 & DC2  OF STATE MONITOR
2) Check Fast Shutdown connection.
3) If point 1 & 2 found ok but error still persist the State monitor needs to be relaced.
F03-KF13:8EM5903-0AA00-6AA1 :QTY1
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.

unified service process
